summary: Cheap opt-in pre-planning ideation: Phase 0 reuses the shared z-sharpen component when GRILL.md is absent, then parses ideator count, probes scope, dispatches ideators, writes BRAINSTORM.md, and waits for user discussion/lock-in without auto-dispatching /z-plan.

entry_points.summary: Derive slug, initialize run dirs/Run Brief, emit start event, handle existing BRAINSTORM.md.
Inventory plus optional scout classifier; warning-only findings never route.
Runs shared sharpen before scope-probe and Phase 1 scaffolding (heading renamed from prior version).
If GRILL.md absent, use shared z-sharpen component inline; wrapper not invoked.
Infer WIDE_N from natural-language count signals; default 3, initial cap 20.
Deterministic routing signals plus optional planning-router; runs before Phase 2 dispatch.
Assemble docs, optional Explore, terrain, GRILL seed, and input_hash.
Persona draw and parallel Claude/Codex/Gemini five-section ideators.
Wide cost gate, overflow waves, overflow model handling.
After all wide waves, cluster N framings into K directions; failure falls back to raw framings.
Write BRAINSTORM.md, anti-bias check, ranked briefing, hard end-turn invariant.
HEAVY chosen_pair or LIGHT/MEDIUM chosen_framing discussion-loop finalization.
Shared diverge/refine two-ideator helper with optional cap.
Wide-mode read-only clustering agent; groups N framings into K by core hypothesis axis.

invariants: If GRILL.md exists, Phase 0 reuses it and emits sharpen_gate without asking questions.
Absent GRILL.md triggers the shared z-sharpen component inline; /z-sharpen wrapper is never invoked from /z-brainstorm.
A component proceed recommendation is advisory only and never auto-dispatches /z-plan.
Phase 1 scaffolding is identical for all ideators except persona prefixes.
Wide mode must present a conversational cost gate and wait for user confirmation before overflow dispatch.
Phase 3 writes BRAINSTORM.md and then hard-stops; no tool call or auto-selection before user reply.
HEAVY successful lock-in uses chosen_pair and removes chosen_framing; abandon uses chosen_framing: abandoned and no chosen_pair.
ideator_personas is always written, including <none> and failed slots.
gotchas: Old sharpen-vs-skip specificity heuristic is obsolete; current behavior uses the shared component whenever GRILL.md is absent.
The /z-sharpen command wrapper owns slug/collision/telemetry/handoff behavior; /z-brainstorm owns its own run lifecycle.
cheap-mixed overflow model logs a warning and falls back to haiku.
Wide overflow maximum is 9 total ideators; over-cap requests are reported to the user.
MAP.md is canonical terrain; approach-synthesis RESEARCH.md is skipped.
Clusterer failure is non-fatal and falls back to raw N framings.
Refine mode is positive-seed depth; diverge mode is anti-seed breadth.

Section line numbers drift as SKILL.md grows (e.g. Plan Route Check now precedes Phase 1 at line 483, Phase 1 itself starts at 526) — re-grep headings rather than trusting stale line numbers when in doubt.
